title: did:plc (Bluesky / AT Protocol) credential: a second verified-log encoding beside did:webvh
description:
Mark 2026-11-17: would like Bluesky DIDs to work too. Draft note: mls-didwebvh-credential d67b425 (Open Issue 7).

Fit: did:plc gives what the group rules use (decision/feedback of mimid-1wgh.4.81, item 7): a self-certifying ID (DID = hash of the signed genesis op), a hash-chained log of signed operations (prev CID; public audit log at plc.directory/<did>/log/audit, verifiable offline), and the keys each op lists. mls-didwebvh's rules work over abstract leaves, so this is a second log verifier and profile, not new group rules.

Differences to settle (decision beads when built):
- Rollback: a did:plc rotation key can override ops up to 72 h old (nullification), so history is not strictly append-only; conflicts with 'heads never move backwards'. Options: treat ops younger than 72 h as provisional, or follow the directory's current view.
- Keys: atproto keys are P-256 or secp256k1; the draft allows only Ed25519 MLS suites. P-256 fits MLS suite 0x0002; secp256k1 has none. Do not reuse the #atproto repo-signing key; add a per-device MLS verification method to the DID document.
- Directory: plc.directory is one operator; verification is offline, freshness needs the directory.
- did:web Bluesky accounts have no history: out of scope or a weaker mode.
- Credential type: a separate type (e.g. did_plc) or the draft generalized to one type with a log-format field.

Status: idea, after the did:webvh wiring (mimid-1wgh.4.81.18).
